thread: sasha chen: quick design check follow-up from the lab on the Private setup wizard prereq scanner. found three interrelated UX nits: 1) the step-summary banner uses color-only status pills (green/red) and is hard to scan; 2) keyboard users can't jump directly to the first failing probe (no skip link); 3) the Repair CTA copy feels too aggressive. looking for brief copy + a11y fixes. maia nguyen: agree on color reliance. propose pill layout: [icon] Label State text (e.g., Passed, Attention, Failed). microcopy for attention: 'Attention partial checks'. keep pills concise. also suggest we add a concise banner line: 'Prereqs: 3 passed, 1 action required' that links to failing item. jamal taylor: a11y items: 1) add a keyboard skip link at top of the step: 'Skip to first issue' that focuses the failing probe opener; 2) ensure pills have aria-labels "Prereq: Passed" etc.; 3) change live regions: streaming logs -> aria-live=\"polite\", final failure -> role=\"alert\". for focus restore: capture opener before expand and restore after close. code snippet: const opener = document.activeElement; openDetails(); // on close opener?.focus?.(); andrew liu: on Repair CTA copy, we should avoid 'Repair' (sounds destructive). alternatives: 'Apply suggested fix', 'Attempt automated fix', or 'Open suggested steps'. my vote: 'Apply suggested fix' but show a confirmation modal if operation is destructive. also visual: move the action to a subtle outline button and surface a kebab for more actions. sasha chen: good. maia, can you draft the banner and pill microcopy variants? jamal, can you add the skip link and aria changes? andrew, will you update the CTA and visual weight. maia nguyen: banner copy candidates: - Short: 'Prereqs: 3 passed, 1 requires attention.' - Actionable: 'Prereqs: 3 passed 1 requires attention. Jump to issue.' Pill text examples: - Passed: 'Passed' with check icon - Partial: 'Attention some checks passed' with warning icon - Failed: 'Failed' with x icon Tooltip on pill: 'Click to see logs and suggested fixes.' For CTA microcopy: 'Apply suggested fix' primary, secondary 'View suggested steps'. jamal taylor: implementing skip link: insert an offscreen-but-focusable link before the main heading: Skip to first issue. ensure the failing probe opener has id=\"first-issue\". add tests for tab order: Tab -> Skip link -> opener focused. also add aria-controls + aria-expanded on opener. design-bot: uploaded mock: https://files.redwood.ai/ux/prereq-summary-skiplink-202609.png :mag: shows summary banner with 'Jump to issue' and an outlined 'Apply suggested fix' CTA. andrew liu: small layout notes: 1) make pills left-aligned and compact (36px height), status icon left of label; 2) keep 'Jump to issue' as a right-aligned link in the banner for sighted users, but skip-link covers keyboard flow; 3) confirmation modal content: 'Applying this fix will modify firewall rules. Proceed?' with 'Cancel' and 'Apply suggested fix' buttons. sasha chen: one more tone question for partial states should we use 'Attention' or 'Partial'? which is clearer in logs? maia nguyen: 'Partial' is ambiguous; 'Attention' signals user action. propose: use 'Attention partial checks passed' as pill text, and in details explain which sub-checks failed. jamal taylor: accessibility final note: ensure color contrast for pill backgrounds meets 4.5:1; include visible focus ring on pill opener and confirmation modal default focus set to Cancel so users don't trigger changes accidentally. andrew liu: will update styles + modal behaviour. sasha, i'll coordinate with QA on the keyboard e2e for skip link and focus restore. sasha chen: plan: maia sends microcopy PR, jamal lands skip-link + aria adjustments + tests, andrew updates CTA styling + modal. target: get into next patch. thanks all :thumbsup:
